blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every company has many people. They have different jobs. We call these jobs roles.

At the top, there is the CEO. Then we have directors, managers, team leaders, and team members. Each role has a clear job to do.

When we understand the structure, we know who to talk to. We know who makes the decisions and who does the work. This is called the organisational structure.

items.q: What do we call the different jobs in a company?
items.why: "We call these jobs roles." — os cargos são chamados de roles.

items.q: Who is at the top of the company?
items.why: "At the top, there is the CEO."

items.q: What does the organisational structure help us know?
options: Who to talk to and who makes decisions
items.why: "we know who to talk to. We know who makes the decisions and who does the work."

items.q: The text suggests that knowing the structure is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que entender a estrutura ajuda a saber com quem falar — é útil para todos.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: each person in a company has a clear job
only the CEO has a real job
items.why: Inferência: "Each role has a clear job to do." — cada função tem um trabalho claro.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando a estrutura da empresa. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, and welcome to the team! It's your first day, so let me show you how our company works.

At the top, we have our CEO. Her name is Sofia. She makes the big decisions for the whole company. Below her, we have three directors. Each director takes care of a large area of the business.

Then we have the managers. I am a manager. I run the sales department. Every manager has a team, and each team has a team leader. The team leader helps the group every day.

You are a team member now, so you report to your team leader, Marco. He is very kind, and he can answer your questions. If you have a big problem, Marco talks to me, and I talk to my director.

Don't worry — you don't need to remember everything today. Just remember one thing: if you need help, ask Marco first. He is always happy to help new people. Welcome again, and enjoy your first day!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is the CEO of the company?
items.why: "At the top, we have our CEO. Her name is Sofia."

items.q: What is James's role?
items.why: "I am a manager. I run the sales department."

items.q: Who should the new employee ask for help first?
items.why: "if you need help, ask Marco first."

items.q: The audio suggests that James wants the new employee to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "Don't worry" e "enjoy your first day" — quer que a pessoa se sinta bem-vinda.

items.q: What can we infer about how problems move in the company?
options: They go from the team member up to the director
items.why: Inferência: o membro fala com Marco, Marco fala com James, James fala com o diretor — sobe pela estrutura.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My role in the company is to help customers." A role is…
items.why: Role = função/cargo — o trabalho que a pessoa faz.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ my manager, so I tell her about my work."
items.why: To report to = se reportar a — dar satisfação do trabalho a alguém.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A ___ runs a department or a team in the company."
items.why: Manager = gerente — quem cuida de um departamento ou equipe.

items.q: "The sales department is on the second floor." A department is…
options: a part or area of the company
items.why: Department = departamento — uma área da empresa.

items.q: "The CEO makes an important decision every week." A decision is…
options: a choice about what to do
items.why: Decision = decisão — uma escolha sobre o que fazer.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "On your first day, someone will show you around the office." To show you around means to…
options: take you to see the different places
items.why: Show someone around = mostrar os lugares, apresentar o local a alguém.

items.q: "The manager takes care of the sales team." To take care of means to…
items.why: Take care of = cuidar de, ser responsável por.

items.q: "New employees, please fill in this form." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações.

items.q: "If you have a question, you can ask for help." To ask for means to…
items.why: Ask for = pedir algo, dizer que você quer aquilo.

items.q: "Welcome to the team! We are happy to have you on board." On board means…
items.why: On board = a bordo, ou seja, agora faz parte da equipe.
